title: Development and validation of a smartwatch algorithm for differentiating physical activity intensity in health monitoring.
summary: The primary study trained SVM/regression models on smartwatch signals and measured energy expenditure, then evaluated activity-intensity estimates in adult and child cohorts against indirect calorimetry. This is a specific measurement-validation result, not evidence of health benefit.
